subject: MAP: Technical Evaluation Plan — next steps & benchmarks
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-10T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: Technical evaluation plan (draft)

Hi Alex / Priya —

Great to connect earlier today. As promised, I put together a short draft of the Mutual Action Plan milestone for the technical evaluation so we have clear owners, success criteria, and a target close window. Summary below and attached is the MAP spreadsheet (Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx) with milestones and dates.

Milestone: Technical evaluation plan
- Goal: Validate model quality + production economics for Acme's document summarization pipeline before committing to Dedicated capacity.
- Success criteria (benchmarks):
  - Quality: ROUGE/Large-model human baseline delta <= 5 points on the 1k-sample eval set OR stakeholder sign-off from Priya and product team
  - Latency: p50 < 150 ms, p95 < 400 ms for 512-token input (warm caches) on Redwood-hosted inference; Dedicated targets to be within 20% of hosted numbers
  - Cost: estimated inference cost <= $0.06 per 1k tokens for selected model/config (target to be refined after quantization tests)

Candidate model shortlist (initial):
1) Llama 2 70B (int8/quantized variant) — prioritized for quality
2) Mistral-Instruct (30B) — strong single-turn inference throughput
3) OPT-30B / Redmond-optimized variant — fallback for cost-sensitive configs

Plan & responsibilities:
- Acme (Priya / Alex): provide representative test corpus (5k doc->summary pairs), acceptance criteria, and a small set of production traffic traces for latency characterization — due 2027-07-17.
- Redwood (Camila + Eng team): run end-to-end benchmarks (quality, latency, throughput), provide quantized cost estimates, and deliver a short write-up with recommended model/config per SLA target — target delivery 2027-07-31.
- Procurement/Legal: Redwood (Rishi) will share estimated contract cadence and Dedicated capacity timeline once benchmark results are validated.

Dependencies / risks:
- Access to a representative test corpus — if delayed, evaluation will use synthetic traffic which may under/over-estimate latency/cost.
- Security/compliance review for any PII-containing samples — Priya to advise on sanitized data or provide an isolated VPC option.

Target close date for MAP milestone: 2027-08-05 (depends on sample delivery).

Next actions:
1) Alex/Priya: confirm the 5k sample delivery date (ideally by 7/17).
2) Schedule a 30-min sync to walk through the benchmark plan — proposed windows next week (I included times in the MAP spreadsheet).
3) Rishi: placeholder for procurement timeline and procurement contacts.

Thanks — happy to iterate on the success criteria.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
Attach: Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Date: 2027-07-11T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical evaluation plan (draft)

Thanks Camila — this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications before we lock dates: 

1) Sample corpus: we can commit to providing ~5k doc/summary pairs but need to confirm sanitization. Priya, we may need to redact PII; are you able to confirm by EOD 7/13?
2) For the latency targets, can you confirm whether p95 is measured on warm caches or cold (cold would be slower)?
3) Is Redwood able to run the same benchmarks on Dedicated hardware (we're interested in tradeoffs between hosted vs dedicated)?

Also looping in our infra lead (cc'd Priya) — if you could include an estimate of Dedicated provisioning lead time (ballpark), that would be helpful for our procurement planning.

Alex
Director of Product, Acme Financial

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-12T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical evaluation plan (draft)

Thanks Alex — great questions. Quick answers below and I updated the attached benchmark plan (redwood_benchmark_plan.pdf) with measurement definitions.

- p95 measurement: we'll report both warm-cache and cold-start percentiles. The MAP baseline numbers listed are warm-cache (typical steady-state behavior). We'll include cold-starts separately for completeness.
- Dedicated benchmarks: yes — we can run on both Redwood-hosted and a Dedicated pool. Our evaluation will report both and highlight any delta.
- Sample sanitization: understood on the PII front — Priya, if you prefer, we can accept a sanitized subset (we'll provide a script to help strip PII) or you can provide test data in an isolated VPC for the Dedicated run.
- Sample size & metrics: we'll run quality eval on the 5k pairs (train/holdout split as discussed) and produce ROUGE/BLEU + human spot checks for edge cases. Latency tests will use a 1k-request trace constructed from your traffic patterns.

Estimated cost guidance (pre-quantization):
- Llama 2 70B (quantized): $0.04 - $0.07 per 1k tokens
- Mistral-Instruct 30B: $0.03 - $0.06 per 1k tokens
- OPT-30B baseline: $0.02 - $0.05 per 1k tokens

Rishi — can you confirm procurement lead times and whether we should start a statement-of-work draft now?

If that looks good, I'll plan to kick off the benchmark suite as soon as we have the samples. Proposed follow-up: 30-min sync on 7/16 to confirm sample handoff and timeline.

Best,
Camila
Attach: redwood_benchmark_plan.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-13T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical evaluation plan (draft)

Thanks team — quick internal note:

- Camila, please confirm resource allocation with Eng (we have a 1-2 engineer day expectation for the initial benchmark run plus 1 day for quantization checks). I'll block that from Eng's side once you confirm.
- Rishi, please prepare a short procurement note outlining estimated Dedicated lead time (ballpark) and the minimal information we need from Acme to generate an SOW.

I'll wait for Alex/Priya to confirm sample sanitization path. Once we have that, Camila can schedule the 7/16 sync.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
